plugins.name: ARC Explorer
plugins.author: Tessera
plugins.description: Browses the Smash Ultimate data.arc like ArcExplorer and extracts files into an extracted folder of the project.

plugins.name: Archives
plugins.author: Tessera
plugins.description: Extracts and repacks SARC archives (layout.arc, .sarc, .szs) like Switch Toolbox.

plugins.name: ARCropolis Config
plugins.author: Tessera
plugins.description: Adds project files to the mod's ARCropolis config.json from the Explorer right-click menu.

plugins.name: Deploy
plugins.author: Tessera
plugins.description: Exports the project and copies the mod into the mods folder of an emulator or the SD card.

plugins.name: Layouts
plugins.author: Tessera
plugins.description: Views and edits .bflyt UI layouts: pane tree, textured preview, positions, sizes, colors and textures, like Switch Toolbox.

plugins.name: Models
plugins.author: Tessera
plugins.description: Views Smash Ultimate models (.numdlb, .numshb) in 3D with their textures, skeleton (.nusktb) and animations (.nuanmb), and edits their materials (.numatb), like SSBH Editor.

plugins.name: MOSAIC Bridge
plugins.author: Compages Works
plugins.description: Exports the project and copies the mod into MOSAIC's mods folder.

plugins.name: MSBT
plugins.author: Tessera
plugins.description: Edits game texts in .msbt and .xmsbt files (names, menus, descriptions), like the Switch Toolbox MSBT editor.

plugins.name: NUS3AUDIO
plugins.author: Tessera
plugins.description: Edits Smash Ultimate .nus3audio files: list, rename, extract, replace, add and remove tracks, and create new files. Opens audio files in the editor of your choice, like Audacity.

plugins.name: Portraits
plugins.author: Tessera
plugins.description: Aligns a new render onto every chara_X portrait frame automatically, then cuts portraits with a movable, paintable mask, like SmashAlign.

plugins.name: PRC
plugins.author: Tessera
plugins.description: Edits game params in .prc, .stprm and .stdat files (fighter stats, items, stages), with names from ParamLabels.

plugins.name: Textures
plugins.author: Tessera
plugins.description: Converts textures between .nutexb, .dds, .png and other images, like Ultimate Tex.

plugins.name: Video
plugins.author: Tessera
plugins.description: Converts videos to .h264 with ffmpeg, the format of Smash Ultimate movies (Final Smash cutscenes).
